sources.title: DDFD: Diffusion-Based Denoising Fusion for Object Detection in Infrared ...
sources.snippet: To extract key fusion features and remove redundancy, DDFD uses an image-aware noise estimator (INE) to determine the noise in the input infrared-visible images for promoting the diffusion denoising network.
